findings.problem: Runs unchanged application validation for documentation/task/evidence-only PRs.
findings.recommendation: Add change classification and preserve a stable required CI result while skipping expensive application jobs for docs-only classes. Keep full CI for shared/runtime/dependency changes.

findings.problem: The broadest production-like matrix runs for documentation-only PRs, although the repository matrix says heavy validation belongs after coherent affected implementation.
findings.recommendation: Gate the heavy validate job on runtime, migration, dependency, deployment, security or production-contract changes. Emit a successful classified no-op/aggregator result when unaffected.

findings.problem: Runs for unrelated documentation and non-edge changes.
findings.recommendation: Run for application HTTP/security headers, trusted proxy, routes/middleware, deployment edge files and the workflow/tests themselves; include explicit shared-dependency paths.

findings.problem: Runs for changes that cannot affect Platform database mutation failure behavior.
findings.recommendation: Gate on application bootstrap, exception/error handling, registration/auth mutations, database/config/migrations, logging and this workflow/test boundary.

findings.problem: Runs for all PRs instead of game-auth ticket/session/concurrency paths.
findings.recommendation: Gate on ticket/session domain, migrations, auth integration contracts and the test/workflow itself.

findings.problem: No defect proven in PR path scoping.
findings.recommendation: Retain path scope; audit push-to-main behavior separately because it is currently unfiltered and may intentionally provide post-merge evidence.

findings.problem: No documentation-only trigger defect proven; path scope is broad but relevant to image contents and deployment.
findings.recommendation: Retain path scoping; consider matrix-level change classification so only affected images build when safe, while deployment manifest changes may require all images/package validation.

findings.trigger_scope: game gateway and its workflow only
findings.recommendation: Use as the component-scoped reference pattern.

estimated_duplicate_setup.note: Counts cover only workflow definitions directly inspected in this audit and are lower bounds.

safe_remediation_principles: Do not remove required check names before branch-protection compatibility is verified.
Prefer one cheap classifier and successful no-op aggregators for unaffected required workflows.
Do not path-filter security-critical gates so narrowly that shared framework/config/dependency changes bypass them.
Run one coherent exact-final-head heavy matrix instead of repeating it after documentation checkpoints.
Use reusable setup or cached artifacts only when isolation and evidence identity remain explicit.
Validate the candidate trigger policy against positive, negative and boundary change sets before rollout.
